$comment: The key set every brand's strings.is.json must provide, exactly. Code references these keys only, never a brand's text. A value is either a whole sentence (a string) or, when plural is true, an object with the Icelandic CLDR categories one and other. Placeholders are written {name} and must match the declared set in every brand. A placeholder never carries the brand name: the name inflects, so each brand writes its own whole sentences (docs/decisions/0004).

app_name.description: Launcher label, home-screen name, store-facing display name.

tab_me.description: Bottom tab: own profile and settings.

new_conversation.description: Action that starts a new conversation.

contact_action.description: Button on an invite landing that opens a conversation with the inviter.

invite.description: Share your own invite link or QR code (docs/decisions/0009).

verified_with_kennitala.description: Badge on a person verified through Kenni.

push_fallback_body.description: APNs alert text shown when the notification service extension cannot decrypt in time. Never names the sender.

new_device_card.description: System card in a conversation when a member adds a device (from an MLS add commit).

history_device_local_notice.description: Explains that a new device sees only messages sent after it joined (docs/decisions/0006).

invite_link_title.description: Heading of the screen with the user's own invite link and QR code.

invite_link_hint.description: Explains what the invite link does.

invite_link_rotate.description: Replace the invite link; the old one stops working.

invite_required.description: Shown after Kenni sign-in without a valid invite during the closed test (docs/decisions/0009).

link_invited_by.description: Heading of the invite link page (/l/{token}) when a person sent the link (docs/decisions/0019).

link_invited.description: Heading of the invite link page when the operator sent the link, or the inviter has no name.

link_open_in_app.description: Button on the invite link page that opens the invite in the app.

link_test_group.description: Invite link page: the app is in a closed test, and how to get it.

link_expired.description: Invite link page for a link that was rotated, revoked or never existed.

new_group.description: Action that starts a new group.

attach.description: Attach a photo or file to a message.

edited_marker.description: Marker on a message that was edited.

delete_for_everyone.description: Delete an own message on every member's devices.

message_deleted.description: Tombstone left where a deleted message was.

react.description: Add a reaction to a message.

disappearing_messages.description: Per-conversation setting: messages delete themselves after a set time.

disappearing_set_card.description: System card when a member sets the disappearing timer; duration is formatted by the client.

disappearing_off_card.description: System card when a member turns the disappearing timer off.

read_marker.description: Marker on an own message the other party has read.

read_receipts_setting.description: Toggle in Me: send read markers.

read_receipts_hint.description: Explains that the read-marker toggle is reciprocal.

typing_setting.description: Toggle in Me: send typing indicators.

typing_indicator.description: Shown while another member is typing.

delete_account_confirm.description: Confirmation before deleting the account; says what the server deletes and what it cannot.

residency_claim.description: The only permitted statement about where data lives (docs/decisions/0001).
